item.title: What 40 ML Studies in Geriatric Care Reveal About External Validation
item.description: Reading notes on Mangio et al. (2026): out of 40 ML studies using multidimensional geriatric assessment data, zero reported external validation, only 4 checked calibration, and none evaluated real-world care allocation impact.
